name: Nonprofit / NGO Organization
description: Mission-driven organization structure for nonprofits, NGOs, and charitable foundations. Executive Director leads with program directors managing thematic or geographic initiatives. Development/fundraising team is revenue engine.

org_structure.overview: Nonprofits are mission-driven organizations where every role connects back to the organization's social or environmental purpose. The revenue engine (development/fundraising) exists to fund programs, not generate profit. Board of Directors provides fiduciary oversight. Funding is typically grants, individual donations, corporate sponsorships, and earned revenue.

roles.title: Executive Director
roles.description: Sets vision, leads fundraising strategy, manages board relations, represents externally.

roles.title: Deputy Director
roles.description: Oversees day-to-day operations, coordinates across departments, ensures program goals.

roles.title: Director of Development
roles.description: Leads fundraising strategy, cultivates major donors, sets revenue targets.

roles.title: Grant Writer
roles.description: Researches and writes grant proposals, manages grant calendar and compliance.

roles.title: Major Gifts Officer
roles.description: Cultivates and solicits major donors, manages portfolios and stewardship.

roles.title: Program Director
roles.description: Leads a program area, designs strategy, manages managers, ensures outcomes.

roles.title: Program Manager
roles.description: Manages specific initiatives, coordinates field staff, tracks metrics.

roles.title: Communications Director
roles.description: Leads communications strategy, brand, media relations.

roles.title: Digital Marketing Manager
roles.description: Manages social media, email campaigns, website content.

roles.title: Finance Director
roles.description: Oversees financial operations, grant compliance, audit.

roles.title: Grants Manager
roles.description: Tracks grant budgets, ensures funder compliance, prepares reports.

key_relationships: Program and Development must be tightly aligned — programs provide impact stories that fuel fundraising
Finance works with Programs to ensure grant compliance and accurate spending
Board provides fiduciary oversight and often includes key donors
